description: A venue operations director must approve the binding production plan for a live filmmaker Q&A at an outdoor festival courtyard, including the microphone system, recording format, public release date, and required production commitments.

shared_context.S1: The festival's outdoor courtyard will host a live filmmaker Q&A after the evening screening.
shared_context.S2: The Q&A is planned for four speakers and will be recorded for the festival's podcast feed.
shared_context.S3: Mara must approve the final production and release plan before the courtyard is opened to guests.
shared_context.S4: The festival's standard production meeting requires the sound and rights leads to submit recorded status-report entries before Mara signs off on the plan.

PF1.text: Jonah completed an RF survey of the courtyard after the soundcheck and found that wireless microphones are unreliable there because of interference from the neighboring broadcast compound; the Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones, and the survey report is still awaiting upload to the production folder.

PF2.text: Elena confirmed with the filmmaker's representative that the appearance release permits an audio-only recording, prohibits public video release, and allows the podcast episode to be released only on September 15, 2026; the confirmation arrived after the rights packet was circulated and has not yet been entered in the event file.

acceptance_conditions: The Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones.
Wireless microphones must not be permitted.
The public release date must be exactly September 15, 2026.
A sound-system documentation commitment targeting Jonah must be logged.
A rights-documentation commitment targeting Elena must be logged.
The rights restriction must be cited by the decision-maker after being spoken aloud by its owner.

content_checks.C1: decisions['wireless_microphones_permitted'] == False and decisions['microphone_setup'] in ['four wired microphones', 'Four wired microphones', 'Four wired microphones, one per speaker', 'Four wired microphones (one per speaker)', 'Four wired microphones, no wireless', 'Four wired microphones, no wireless, set up and ready before the courtyard opens to guests', 'Four wired microphones (one per speaker), no wireless microphones due to RF interference from neighboring broadcast compound', 'Four wired microphones, one per speaker, due to RF interference from the neighboring broadcast compound making wireless microphones unreliable in the courtyard.', 'Four wired microphones, no wireless, set up and ready before the courtyard opens to guests']
content_checks.C3: decisions['recording_format'] in ['audio-only', 'Audio-only recording', 'Audio-only recording, no public video release', 'Audio-only recording (no public video release)', 'Audio-only recording for the podcast feed; no public video release permitted per the appearance release constraints.', 'Audio-only recording for podcast feed; no video release permitted', 'Audio-only recording, no public video release permitted']
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'sound_system_documentation' and c['target'] == 'Jonah' and c['detail'] == 'Upload the RF survey report for the four wired microphones before the courtyard opens.' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'rights_documentation' and c['target'] == 'Elena' and c['detail'] == 'Enter the appearance-release restrictions and September 15, 2026 podcast release date in the event file.' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The RF survey changes the microphone choice from an ordinary wireless setup to exactly four wired microphones, forbids wireless use, and requires a sound-system documentation commitment targeting Jonah for the survey report.

The appearance release changes the recording to audio-only, fixes the public release date at September 15, 2026, and requires a rights-documentation commitment targeting Elena plus citation of PF2 after Elena states it aloud.
